name: Sunray Galley 400SH | 4-Person Traditional Barrel Sauna
description: Description The SunRay Galley 4-Person Traditional Barrel Sauna is perfectly designed for group relaxation or for stretching out on its long side benches. Measuring 6' deep by 6' wide, it’s the ideal size for your backyard retreat. Equipped with a powerful 6.0 kW Harvia electric heater, the Galley sauna reaches 170–180°F and features a built-in delay timer that lets you schedule your session up to 8 hours in advance. This complete sauna kit includes a flat floor kit and a shingled roof for added protection in wetter climates. An accessory package provides a thermo-hygrometer, water bucket with ladle, sand timer, and sauna stones for authentic steam sessions. Dome interior lighting creates the perfect ambience, while the solid red cedar ball-and-socket construction and stainless steel hardware ensure durability and timeless appeal.
